name: HireVue
summary: Hiring platform for video interviews, AI-led interviews, assessments and scheduling.
description: HireVue offers video interviewing, an AI interviewer, pre-employment assessments, an assessment builder, candidate matching and scheduling, and fraud mitigation. It is free for candidates; employers buy it through sales, and no public prices are listed. Products cover the engage, screen, assess and interview stages of hiring. The platform includes integrations with other HR systems and an automation layer. The company publishes material on the science behind its assessments.
